description: Sophia Script for Windows (Windows 11, PowerShell 7). The most advanced PowerShell module on GitHub for fine-tuning Windows and automating routine tasks.
notes: This package provides Sophia Script for Windows 11, PowerShell 7 only.
Other editions: sophia-script, sophia-script-ltsc2024, sophia-script-ltsc2024-ps7, sophia-script-win10, sophia-script-win10-ps7, sophia-script-ltsc2019, sophia-script-ltsc2021.
The Sophia and SophiaScript commands start a launcher. It runs Sophia.ps1 in PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) from any shell (PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7 or CMD).
This edition needs PowerShell 7.6 or newer.
This edition needs Windows 11 build 26300.9445 or newer.
Sophia.ps1 is the preset. Your function selections in it are not kept on update. Keep your own copy of the edited file and use it after each update.
pre_install: abort "This package is for Windows 11 (build 26300.9445 or newer), PowerShell 7. Detected: $ProductName (build $Build.$UBR). Run 'scoop search sophia-script' to pick the right edition."
if (-not $PwshCommand) { warn 'This edition runs on PowerShell 7.6 or newer only. Install it: scoop install main/pwsh' }
elseif ($PwshCommand.Version -lt [version]'7.6') { warn "This edition needs PowerShell 7.6 or newer. Found: $($PwshCommand.Version). Update it: scoop update pwsh" }
